t: Photonic Computer: Waveguide Loss Budget — Simple
name: Photonic Computer: Waveguide Loss Budget — Simple
title: Photonic Computer: Waveguide Loss Budget — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] Light fades in waveguides: the desk budgets the propagation loss per centimeter and the total per path. A 3 dB/cm waveguide over 5 cm eats 97% of the light — the budget says so before the tape-out.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Surviving fraction after 15 dB loss = 0.0316 fraction. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

real_world_basis: Loss budgeting is the real basis of photonic integrated-circuit design.
signature_version: Signature version: the manifestation waveguide desk — the chapter's target as the loss target, with the manifestation framing labeled concept.

math_note: Surviving fraction after 15 dB loss: 0.0316 fraction [verified]; Loss for 5 cm at 3 dB/cm: 15.0 dB [verified]
safety: No hazard; the failure mode is a design budgeted on typical loss.
how_it_works: Multiply the loss per cm by the path length for the total dB, convert to the surviving fraction. The demo budgets a mesh network.
